question: Who was the son and successor of Chandragupta II?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Kumaragupta I**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kumaragupta I** was the **son and successor** of **Chandragupta II**, one of the greatest emperors of the **Gupta Dynasty**.
 
• He ascended the throne around **415 CE** and ruled for approximately **40 years**.
 
• Kumaragupta I is known for maintaining the **stability and prosperity** of the Gupta Empire during his reign.&
